SELECT o.order_id, o.order_user_id, o.order_title, o.order_amount, o.order_status, o.create_time, o.update_time FROM ch_order o WHERE o.order_is_delete = 0
AND o.order_status = #{orderStatus}
AND (o.create_time > #{cursorTime} OR (o.create_time = #{cursorTime} AND o.order_id > #{cursorId}))
AND (o.create_time < #{cursorTime} OR (o.create_time = #{cursorTime} AND o.order_id < #{cursorId}))
ORDER BY o.create_time ASC, o.order_id ASC
ORDER BY o.create_time DESC, o.order_id DESC
LIMIT #{pageSize}
